query: My agent re-runs daily on the same 500 assets and re-derives the same conclusions every time — how do I make it remember what it already learned?
expected_behavior: Identifies this as the durable-per-asset-memory gap this skill fills, not a search or one-off enrichment task
Explains that agent_memory.py's load_belief() resumes log_odds/mass/provenance from the agent.* structured properties already on each asset, so each run continues the prior posterior
Notes that structuredProperties is a full-replace aspect, so persistence must read the current property set before writing any subset of it, or it silently erases sibling fields
Mentions staleness decay (Belief.decay) as the mechanism for assets that go unobserved for a while, pulling belief back toward the neutral prior rather than keeping stale certainty forever
Points to running scripts/belief.py standalone to see the accumulation mechanism without needing a live DataHub instance
